note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a VIE 19; A06b VIE 19; L05 No provision): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen keeps it on taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Dual citizenship restriction), A01b (descent, born abroad: Dual citizenship restriction), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, a child born abroad on the limit the dataset states. The coding also records a dual-citizenship restriction on descent, which the form doesn't hold. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Vietnam, 2024
sources.said: Person has been resident in Vietnam for 5 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required (permission for retention of citizenship can be granted). ... n.a. ... Dual citizenship restriction ... Person is born in Vietnam to two citizens, to a citizen and a parent who is stateless, or to a mother who is a citizen and the father is unknown. If one parent is a citizen and the other parent is a citizen of another country, the child acquires Vietnamese citizenship if the parents agree in writing, but also if they do not reach agreement. ... Dual citizenship restriction ... Person is born abroad to two citizens, to a citizen and the other parent is stateless, or to a mother who is a citizen and the father is unknown. If one parent is a citizen and the other parent is a citizen of another country, the child acquires Vietnamese citizenship if the parents agree in writing, but also if they do not reach agreement. ... No provision ... No provision

atBirth.descentAbroad: Person is born abroad to two citizens, to a citizen and the other parent is stateless, or to a mother who is a citizen and the father is unknown. If one parent is a citizen and the other parent is a citizen of another country, the child acquires Vietnamese citizenship if the parents agree in writing, but also if they do not reach agreement.
